The escalated re-review remains issue-bearing. The header grants two funded rounds, with zero spent. Dispatch funded round 1; do not commit or complete task 3.

Below, `${…}` in dispatch text means literal insertion of the available artifact—not a summary. In particular:
- `TASK_3_TEXT`, `SPEC_ANCHORS`, and `STATUS_PROTOCOL` are available verbatim.
- `ESCALATED_CR_REPORT` is the complete escalated re-review report.
- `WAVE_BASE_SHA` remains the original recorded wave base.
- `PRIOR_CR_TREE` is the tree recorded at the escalated re-review’s dispatch, not a newly captured substitute.

## 1. First funded repair

Print:

```text
funded round 1 of 2 for task 3
```

Dispatch one in-place implementer, using the already-resolved escalation model. No fan-out, worktree isolation, commit instruction, or staging instruction:

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
You are implementing a funded repair for task 3: Validate frame.

## Task Description
${TASK_3_TEXT}

## Spec anchors
${SPEC_ANCHORS}

Repair the findings in the complete prior review report below.
Work in the current integrated implementation checkout.
Preserve unrelated integrated changes.

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

${STATUS_PROTOCOL}

Return an explicit status: DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED.
Report scoped-test evidence and self-review results.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
${ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}
`
})
```

This dispatch spends one funded round. The supplied observation says it returns `DONE` with a nonempty tracked delta and passing scoped tests. The parent still runs the scoped gate:

```bash
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test frame.test.mjs)
```

## 2. Prepare the CR re-review

`Behaviour-change: no` means CR only; do not insert an SR dispatch.

Stage deliverables:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" add -A
```

Capture the current review tree with the complete required block:

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Record the printed SHA as this wave’s new `CURRENT_CR_TREE`. On a nonzero exit, stop review dispatch and report the shell error.

Generate the fix delta using the recorded tree SHAs:

```bash
git -C "/workspace/project" diff --binary "$PRIOR_CR_TREE" "$CURRENT_CR_TREE"
```

Use that complete output as `FIX_DELTA`. The scenario supplies a nonempty tracked delta, so proceed to re-review.

## 3. Funded-round CR re-review

The review source remains the **entire integrated wave against its original base**, including staged and unstaged changes. The fix delta supplements that source; it does not replace it.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  context: "fresh",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review the integrated wave for production readiness using the supplied
code-reviewer template. Read code and git state; do not edit files.
Run only the command listed under SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS.

DESCRIPTION:
Task 3, Validate frame, and its funded repair.
${AVAILABLE_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_REPAIR_SUMMARY}

PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS:
${TASK_3_TEXT}

Spec anchors:
${SPEC_ANCHORS}

BASE_SHA: ${WAVE_BASE_SHA}
HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test frame.test.mjs

Review the current staged and unstaged integrated checkout against BASE_SHA,
not a worker snapshot or a commit range.

Check code quality, architecture, testing, plan deviations, file
responsibilities, decomposition, and size growth introduced by this change.
Report production readiness using the code-reviewer report format.

## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
${ESCALATED_CR_REPORT}

## Fix delta
${FIX_DELTA}

If your task contains a "Previous review report (re-review trigger)" section
and you found issues, append exactly one more line after Behaviour-change:
— this line, not Behaviour-change:, is the true final line of the report:

TRAJECTORY: CONVERGING (<n_prev> -> <n_now>, max severity <X>)
TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: <finding>)

Pick the first label that applies, in this order:

1. STAGNANT: a previous Critical or Moderate finding survives materially
   unchanged — name it.
2. DIVERGING: <n_now> >= <n_prev>, or the fix introduced a new Critical
   or Moderate finding.
3. CONVERGING: otherwise — the Critical/Moderate count fell, no new
   Critical or Moderate appeared, and every surviving Critical or Moderate
   was materially improved.

<n_prev>/<n_now> count Critical and Moderate findings only; Minors —
ride-along Minors declined or unchanged, and (outside fix delta) downgrades
alike — never move the TRAJECTORY: line. <X> is the highest remaining
severity. For this line the severity set is exactly Critical/Moderate/Minor,
regardless of the vocabulary used elsewhere in your report.

The orchestrator dispatches one extra fix only when this line says
CONVERGING without "max severity Critical" — be accurate, not generous.

If you found no issues, report success as usual and omit this line.
First reviews (no previous-report section) omit this line.
`
})
```

No `model:` override is set for the reviewer.

## 4. Consume the supplied re-review observation and stop

The supplied result is `FIX_FIRST` with:

```text
TRAJECTORY: STAGNANT (repeat of: missing length guard)
```

Pattern-match `STAGNANT`: a funded re-review with this trajectory stops immediately, even though one funded round remains. Do not dispatch funded round 2, another escalation, or another review. Do not commit the wave or update task 3 to `complete`; it remains `in_progress`, and phase remains `implement`.

End the turn with this stop note:

```text

Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: Frame validation still lacks the required length guard, so the repair remains unresolved.
budget: 1 of 2 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - "missing length guard"

Fix options:
  a) add the required length guard at src/frame.ts:21 and verify it through the scoped tests and review
  b) amend task 3's validation requirement to explicitly permit the currently unguarded case

Pick one, or give another fix.
```
